objective: Does waiting 0.5%, 1%, or 2% below next open improve DV2, HPI235 vote, and sector VOX/IYR after missed opportunities, portfolio state and costs?

sources.role: entry-policy inspiration; its separate 10-day-low signal is not replicated

data.adjustment: CAPITALSPECIAL traded OHLC and marks; TOTALRETURN SPXTR benchmark
data.membership: native DV2 former-member 5-positive-row tail exclusion; HPI exact PIT; sector fixed 11 ETF basket
data.padding: native loader contracts retained: DV2/sector ALLMARKETDAYS; HPI NONE with valuation-only Close forward fill
data.lineage: data/<strategy>/input_manifest.json hashes exact prices/universe/calendar before execution
data.data_asof: 2026-09-14 Final edition observed in native database metadata
data.intraday: not available in bounded local search

timing.limit_entry: ideal immediate-after-open activation, L=O*(1-d), eligible Low<=L
timing.exit: original Close_T trigger; Open_T+1 market fill
timing.no_fill: cash; no late market fallback, no intraday replacement; next close re-evaluates original signal
timing.critical_boundary: Low is observed only in execution evaluator, never selection, ranking or sizing
timing.terminal: mark residual holdings at final Close; show separately from completed trades

signal.dv2: original DVO2Strategy: DV2_126<10, C>SMA200, Return126>0.05; NATR14 descending; exit C_T>High_T-1
signal.hpi235: at least2 of3 horizons2,3,5 have negative return and HPI<30; IBS<0.1,C>SMA200; turnover descending; exit IBS>.9 OR RSI2>90 OR lost PIT membership
signal.sector: IBS<.05 and (C_T-C_T-1)/ATR14_T-1<-.5; priorNATR14 descending; exit IBS>.9 and log(H/L)>prior21session median; basket XLB XLE XLF XLI XLK XLP XLU XLV XLY VOX IYR

portfolio.quantities: original prior-close quantity rules; DV2/HPI floor(V/10/C); sector fractional V*(1.5/11)/C
portfolio.financing: native unmodeled negative cash; disclose counts/minimum
portfolio.cash_constraints: native may go negative after gaps; do not select fillable candidates retrospectively
portfolio.paired: same native selected opportunity, same quantity, same original exit or terminal mark; misses zero; allocate commission/friction/dividends

evaluation.window: common native calendars after2010 with no results-dependent truncation
evaluation.holdout: none claimed; historic source and internal research already seen
evaluation.inference: paired daily-return HAC lag5, Holm across9 central differences; descriptive known-history only
evaluation.prior_exposure: paper aggregate2010-May2026 seen; prior internal studies on these systems; read-only agent incidentally saw old dividend/cash diagnostics, no new policy results

costs.paper_like: gross paired opportunity decomposition; not literal source reproduction
costs.capacity: selected order ADV63 participation at100k per independent sleeve and same-symbol aggregate diagnostic; no calibrated impact/AUM promotion

promotion_rule: No operational promotion. Describe economic changes per system. Candidate follow-up needs positive central and stress delta, broad period support, sufficient fills, and no decisive data or timing gap; full family always reported.
known_limits: Open activation time unknown from daily OHLC
Native DV2 membership tail uses retrospective noncurrent status
Native missing-price liquidation convention and financing gaps

evidence_waivers.literal_article_replication: user asked transfer into existing systems, not a fourth signal
evidence_waivers.same_close_attribution: paired source diagnostic only; never executable promotion
